# 第38项独立复核

Independent searchsorted windows with explicit endpoint interpolation, supply-current decomposition and complex-power PSR. Eight unmodified upstream check functions run against explicit TT27C two-supply subset and one startup; original other28DC/step,8PSR,3startup points excluded. Independent primitive/hierarchy parse enforces PMOSpass and totalC<=1nF.
